court_name: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
petitioner: The Principal, Modern College of Arts, Science and Commerce, Shivaji Nagar, Pune- 5

directives.text: The judgment and order dated 19 November 2014 passed by the learned Member, Industrial Court, Pune in Complaint (ULP) No. 202 of 2009 is quashed and set aside
Complaint (ULP) No. 202 of 2009 filed by the respondent stands dismissed

raw_summary: The Bombay High Court allowed a writ petition, quashing and setting aside a prior order by the Industrial Court. The Industrial Court had found the petitioner institution guilty of unfair labor practices and directed payment of salary in a prescribed pay scale. The High Court dismissed the respondent's complaint, finding insufficient particulars and a lack of legal basis for the claim of unfair labor practice and entitlement to the claimed pay scale.
